en.title: Bhajan No. 1
en.lyrics:
Gajavadana Gananatha, Gajavadana Vinayaka (2)
Sidhi Vidhatha Shiva Tanya (2)
Budhi Pradayaka Gajanana (2)
Parvati Nandana, Bhav Bhaya Bhanjana (2)
Yuga Yuga Vanditha Jaya Sri Ganesha (2)
Gajavadana Gananatha, Gajavadana Vinayaka (2)
Gajavadana Gananatha, Gajavadana Vinayaka (2)

en.title: Bhajan No. 2
en.lyrics:
Sai Gajanana deenavana
Sai Gajanana deenavana
Sindhuravadana shrithajana pavana
Sai Gajanana deenavana
Ambikathanaya amradheeswara
Aganithagunagana aananda dayaka

en.title: Bhajan No. 3
en.lyrics:
Jai Ganaraya Sri Ganaraya (2)
Jai Ganaraya Sri Ganaraya Ganapathi Bappa Moria (2)
Moria Moria Ganapathi Bappa Moria (2)
Siddhi Vinayaka Bhudi Pradayaka (2)
Siddhi Vinayaka Bhudi Pradayaka Ganapathi Bappa Moria (2)
Moria Moria Ganapathi Bappa Moria (2)
Vigna Vinashaka Vidya Dayaka
Vigna Vinashaka Vidya Dayaka Ganapathi Bappa Moria (2)
Moria Moria Ganapathi Bappa Moria (2)
Mangala Dayaka Moksha pradayaka (2)
Mangala Dayaka Moksha pradayaka Ganapathi Bappa Moria (2)
Moria Moria Ganapathi Bappa Moria (2)

en.title: Bhajan No. 4
en.lyrics:
Amba Mandahasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagajjanani
Maatha Maatha Maatha Jagajjanani //Amba//
Jagajjanani Shubhakarini
Jagajjanani Shubhakarini
Amba Sai Jagannatha Mampahi Jagannatha
Amba Sai Jagannatha Mampahi Jagannatha
Amba Mandahaasa vadani manohari Sai Jagajjanani

en.title: Bhajan No. 5
en.lyrics:
Tame Bolo Maeri Rana Sai Re Sai
Tame Bolo Maeri Rasna Hari Re Hari
Tame Hari Hari Bolo, Tame Har Har Bolo
Tame Bolo Mari Rasna Sai Re Sai
Tame Sai Sai Bolo, Tame Baba Baba Bolo
Tame Bolo Re Mari Rasna, Dutta Jay Guru... Tame...
Tame Dutta Dutta Bolo, Tame Digambar Bolo
Surya Swarupa Sai, Chandra Swarupa Sai
Prema Swarupa Sai, Satya Swarupa Sai
Dharti Swarupa Sai, Ambar Swarupa Sai... Tame...
Dharma Swarupa Sai, Karma Swarupa Sai
Shakti Swarupa Sai, Dhukha Swarupa Sai
Jivan Swarupa Sai, Mrityu Swarupa Sai
Bhakti Swarupa Sai, Mukti Swarupa Sai
Tame Bolo Mari Rasna Sai Re Sai
Tame Sai Sai Bolo, Tame Baba Baba Bolo

en.title: Bhajan No. 6
en.lyrics:
Mera Bhola Baba Ko
Mera Bhola Baba Ko, Anadi Na Samjho
Anadi Na Samjho Anadi Na Samjho
Jholay Lakar Aaya, Magar Bhikari Na Samjho
Bhikari Na Samjho Bhikari Na Samjho
Trishul Lakar Aaya, Magar Shikari Na Samjho
Shikari Na Samjho Shikari Na Samjho
Bhang Pikar Aaya, Magar Sharabi Na Samjho
Sharabi Na Samjho Sharabi Na Samjho
Bhabhut Lagakar Aaya, Magar Agyani Na Samjho
Agyani Na Samjho, Agyani Na Samjho
Damru Le Kar Aaya, Magar Madari Na Samjho
Madari Na Samjho, Madari Na Samjho

en.title: Bhajan No. 7
en.lyrics:
Govinda Madhava, Gopala Keshava (2)
Sainatha Madhava Shirdiwasa Keshava (2)
Jaya Nanda Mukunda, Nanda Govinda Radhe Gopala (2)
Giridhari, Giridhari, Jaya Radhe Gopala (2)
GhanaShyam Shyam Shyam Jaya Jaya Sai Gopala (2)
Jaya Nanda Mukunda, Nanda Govinda Radhe Gopala (2)
Keshava Madhava, Keshava Madhava
Govinda Madhava, Gopala Kesava (2)

en.title: Bhajan No. 8
en.lyrics:
Gurur Brahma Gurur Vishnu
Gurur Devo Maheshwaraha
Guru Shakshath Para Brahma Thasmai Sri Gurave Namaha (3)
Manasa Bhajare Guru Charanam (2)
Dustara Bhava Sagara Tharanam
Guru Maharaj Guru Jai Jai
Sai Natha Sadguru Jai Jai
Om Namah Shivaya (3) Shivaya Namah
Om Arunachala Shiva (3) Aruna Shiva Om
Omkaram Bhava (3) Om Namo Baba
Manasa Bhajare Guru Charanam (2)
Dustara Bhava Sagara Tharanam

en.title: Bhajan No. 9
en.lyrics:
Sai Deva Omkara Roopa
Deva Deva Maam Paahi Sharanam (2)
Sri Guru Charanam Bhavapaapa Haranam,
Karuna Bharanam Sri Sai Charanam (2)
Parama Pavitram Sri Guru SmaraNam,
Anantha Roopam Sri Sai CharaNam (2)

Nirupama Yogam Sri Guru Smaranam
Akhanda Tejam Sri Sai Charanam (2)

Moksha Swaroopam Sri Guru Smaranam
Vaikunta Dhamam Sri Sai Charanam (2)

Madhura Sudhamam Sri Guru Smaranam
Munjiana Paalam Sri Sai Charanam (2)

Eeshwara roopam Sri Sai Smaranam
Mukti Ki Margam Sri Sai Charanam (2)

Shridivasa Sainatha Deva Deva Pahimam
Deva Deva Sainatha Shridivasa Rakshamam (2)
Sainatha Pahimam Shridivasa Rakshamam
Shridivasa Pahimam Sainatha Rakshamam (2)

Sai Deva Omkara Roopa
Deva Deva Mampahi Sharanam (2)

en.title: Bhajan No. 10
en.lyrics:
Oh Bhagvaan-3 Sai Baba Bhagvaan (1)
Oh Bhagvaan-3 Sai Rama Bhagvaan (1)
Oh Bhagvaan-3 Sai Krishna Bhagvaan (1)
Oh Bhagvaan-3 Sai Dattaha Bhagvaan (1)
Prema Bhagavaan Jyothi Bhagavaan Athma Bhagavaan
Paramathma Bhagavaan
Nanda Bhagavaan Ananda Bhagavaan Nithya Nanda Bhagavaan
Brahma Nanda Bhagavaan
Ayodhya Bhagavaan Dwaraka Bhagavaan Shirdi Bhagavaan Sri Sai Bhagavaan
Aaja Bhagavaan -3 Edhar Aaja Bhagavaan

en.title: Bhajan No. 11
en.lyrics:
Sai Baba Sai Baba Sai Baba Sai Baba
Sai Baba Sai Baba Sai Baba Sai Baba
Sai Baba Sai Baba Sai Baba Sai Baba
Sai Baba Sai Baba Sai Baba Sai Baba

en.title: Bhajan No. 12
en.lyrics:
Sai Raham Nazar karna, Baachon ka Paalan Karna.
Jaana Tumne Jagapaasara, Sabhi Jhoot Jamana II Sai
Main Andha hoon Banda Aapka, Mujhko Prabhu Dikhlaana II Sai
Dass Ganu kahe Ab kya Booloon, Thak Gayi Meri Rasna II Sai

en.title: Bhajan No. 13
en.lyrics:
Gam Ganapathi namo namah
Sri Sidhi Vinayaka namo namah
Asta Vinayaka namo namah
Ganapati Bappa moriya

en.title: Bhajan No. 14
en.lyrics:
Ganesha Sharanam Sharanam Ganesha
Ganesha Sharanam Sharanam Ganesha
Ganesha Sharanam Sharanam Ganesha
Ganesha Sharanam Sharanam Ganesha
Saiesha Shranam Sharanam Saiesha
Saiesha Shranam Sharanam Saiesha
Saiesha Shranam Sharanam Saiesha
Saiesha Shranam Sharanam Saiesha

en.title: Bhajan No. 15
en.lyrics:
Gowri nandana Gajanana
Girija nandina Niranjana
Gowri nandana Gajanana
Parvathi nandana shubhanana
Pahi prabhoma, pahi prasanna
Gowri nandana......... //Repeat faster//

en.title: Bhajan No. 16
en.lyrics:
Mangala Charana Gajanana
Gajavadana Shubhanana
Mangala Charana Gajanana

Vidyadayaka Buddhidayaka 
Gowri Tanaya Gajanana (2)
Lambodara Hey Gajanana
Gajavadana Shubhanana //Mangal//

Shubhakaranam Hey Dukhavinasaka 
Aishwaryaka Gajanana (2)
Sindhuravadana Gajanana
Gajavadana Shubhanana //Mangal//

Vighna Vinashaka Punyapala Palaka 
Siddhi Vinayaka Gajanana (2)
Sukshmambardhara Gajanana
Gajavadana Shubhanana
Mangala Charana Gajanana

en.title: Bhajan No. 17
en.lyrics:
Brahmanda nayaka Baba Shirdi pureeshwara Baba
Baba Sai Baba, Baba Sai Baba //Brahmanda//
Chand aur sooraj tumne banayi nadiya sagar tumne banayi //brahmanda//
Ayodhya nagari tumne banayi Dwaraka nagari tumne banayi
banayi //Brahmanda//

en.title: Bhajan No. 18
en.lyrics:
Achutham Keshavam Rama Narayanam
Krishna Damodaram Vasudevam bhaje
Sreedharam Maadhavam Gopika Vallabham
Janaki nayakam Sadguru namakam
Ramachandram bhaje Ramachandram bhaje
